senses.sense_definition: A container or object used for holding or storing things.

examples.text: Please place all your plastic waste in the recycling <w>receptacle</w> provided near the entrance.
The large metal <w>receptacle</w> was filled to the brim with discarded office supplies.

senses.sense_definition: A device installed at an electrical outlet to receive a plug and supply power.

examples.text: Make sure the lamp is firmly pushed into the wall <w>receptacle</w>.
The electrician replaced the old, damaged <w>receptacle</w> with a new safety model.

senses.sense_definition: The thickened end of a flower stalk to which the floral parts are attached.

examples.text: The petals and sepals are arranged in whorls directly on the <w>receptacle</w>.
Botanists examine the <w>receptacle</w> to understand the structural evolution of the flower.

senses.sense_definition: A specialized structure at the end of an algal branch that contains reproductive organs.

examples.text: The reproductive tips of the rockweed are known as <w>receptacles</w>.
Tiny chambers called conceptacles are embedded within the surface of the algal <w>receptacle</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An anatomical organ or structure that receives and holds a secretion.

examples.text: The gland acts as a <w>receptacle</w> for the fluid produced during the digestive process.
Specialized cells form a <w>receptacle</w> to store the chemical secretions safely.
